name: Other Metabolic Disease with Skin Involvement

criteria.description: Presence of characteristic metabolic-related skin lesions such as xanthomas or ichthyosis
Abnormal metabolic laboratory findings including elevated serum lipids or amino acid profiles
Identification of pathogenic mutations in genes associated with metabolic pathways
Positive family history of metabolic disorders with skin involvement
Skin biopsy showing metabolic storage material or characteristic histological changes

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of at least two major criteria including characteristic cutaneous lesions and biochemical abnormalities
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic confirmation supports diagnosis but is not mandatory; histopathology and family history provide additional supportive evidence.

pathognomonic.notes: Firm nodular lesions over tendons, highly suggestive of lipid metabolism disorder
Generalized scaling and thickening of the skin

common.notes: Thickening of skin on palms and soles
searchTerms: thickened skin on palms and soles

common.notes: Yellowish plaques on eyelids due to lipid deposits
Enlarged liver due to metabolic storage

occasional.notes: Sudden appearance of yellow papules on skin

rare.notes: Localized swelling due to metabolic dysfunction
Heart muscle disease secondary to metabolic abnormalities

laboratory: Abnormal amino acid or organic acid profiles
imaging: MRI revealing lipid storage in tissues
genetic: Mutations in genes involved in lipid metabolism (e.g., CYP27A1, ABCD1)
other: Skin biopsy demonstrating lipid-laden macrophages or metabolic storage material

distinguishingFeatures: Predominantly elevated LDL cholesterol without ichthyosis
Absence of systemic metabolic storage signs
Presence of retinitis pigmentosa and neuropathy
Phytanic acid accumulation with different skin manifestations

redFlags: Rapid progression of skin lesions with systemic symptoms
references: Metabolic Skin Disorders: Clinical and Molecular Aspects, Journal of Dermatological Science, 2023
Genetics and Metabolism of Lipid Storage Diseases, Clinical Reviews in Metabolism, 2024
